#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration=.atdd-phpunit.xml "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

/**

 *                    Free-plan scenario; different assertion focus — no side-effects fired)
 */
#[Group('events')]
#[Group('p1')]
class PublishHttpTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use BillingTestFixtures;
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        // Flush PermissionCacheService in-process cache between tests.
        // RefreshDatabase recycles user/team IDs, so a cached capability
        // from test N would bleed into test N+1 for the same ID.
        Cache::flush();
        $this->pinTestClock();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->unpinTestClock();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Helpers
    // =========================================================================

    /**
     * Create a DRAFT event owned by the given admin's current team.
     */
    private function draftEventForAdmin(User $admin, bool $withLanding = true): Event
    {
        $factory = Event::factory()
            ->inState(EventState::DRAFT)
            ->for($admin->currentTeam);

        if ($withLanding) {
            $factory = $factory->withLanding();
        }

        return $factory->create(['created_by' => $admin->id]);
    }

    /**
     * Create a Launch-pass event through the production credit-binding path.
     *
     * @return array{0: Event, 1: PackagePurchase}
     */
    private function launchPassBoundDraftEvent(User $admin, CarbonInterface $expiresAt): array
    {
        $team = $admin->currentTeam;
        $pass = PackagePurchaseFactory::new()
            ->for($team)
            ->launchPass()
            ->active()
            ->create(['expires_at' => $expiresAt]);

        $event = app(EventService::class)->createDraft($team, $admin, [
            'title' => 'Launch Pass Publish Event',
            'description' => 'A bound Launch-pass event used to verify the publish plan gate.',
            'starts_at' => now()->addDays(7),
            'ends_at' => now()->addDays(7)->addHour(),
            'timezone' => 'UTC',
        ]);

        LandingPage::factory()
            ->for($event)
            ->create([
                'team_id' => $team->id,
                'template' => 'classic',
            ]);

        return [$event, $pass->refresh()];
    }

    /**
     * Post to the publish route using the event's UUID (UUID model binding).
     */
    private function publishUrl(Event $event): string
    {
        return route('events.publish', ['event' => $event->uuid]);
    }

    private function fakeLowApproval(): void
    {
        $this->fakeTriage('low', 'approve');
    }

    private function fakeTriage(string $risk, string $verdict): void
    {
        config()->set('ai_audit.auto_triage.enabled', true);
        config()->set('ai_audit.auto_triage.base_url', 'https://vllm.example.test/v1');
        config()->set('ai_audit.auto_triage.model', 'audit-model');
        config()->set('ai_audit.auto_triage.api_key', 'test-runtime-key');

        Http::fake([
            'vllm.example.test/v1/chat/completions' => Http::response([
                'choices' => [[
                    'message' => [
                        'content' => json_encode([
                            'risk' => $risk,
                            'verdict' => $verdict,
                            'reason_codes' => ['publish-http-test'],
                            'reasons' => ['Deterministic test response.'],
                        ], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
                    ],
                ]],
            ]),
        ]);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Tier matrix — happy paths (ACs 1, 2, 6)
    // =========================================================================

    #[Test]
    public function admin_on_pro_plan_can_publish_via_http(): void
    {
        [$admin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $event = $this->draftEventForAdmin($admin);
        $this->fakeLowApproval();

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->postJson($this->publishUrl($event));

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertJsonPath('data.state', EventState::PUBLISHED->value);

        $event->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED, $event->state);
    }

    {

        [$targetAdmin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $globalPublisher = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($systemTeam);
        $event = $this->draftEventForAdmin($targetAdmin);
        $this->fakeLowApproval();

        $response = $this->actingAs($globalPublisher)->postJson($this->publishUrl($event));

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertJsonPath('data.state', EventState::PUBLISHED->value);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::PUBLISHED, $event->refresh()->state);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function global_publish_rejects_when_the_target_event_team_lacks_publish_entitlement(): void
    {
        [, $systemTeam] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        [$targetAdmin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::FREE);
        $globalPublisher = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($systemTeam);
        $event = $this->draftEventForAdmin($targetAdmin);

        $response = $this->actingAs($globalPublisher)->postJson($this->publishUrl($event));

        $response->assertStatus(402);
        $response->assertJsonPath('error.code', 'JKM-EVT-1003');
        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT, $event->refresh()->state);
    }

/**

 * and prepare surfaces do not drift into visible-action / denied-route UX.
 */
class EventActionAvailability
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, array{visible: bool, enabled: bool}>
     */
    public function for(User $actor, Event $event): array
    {
        $cancelled = $event->cancelled_at !== null;
        $canUpdate = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.update.team', 'events.update.global');
        $canPublish = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.publish.team', 'events.publish.global');
        $canCancel = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.cancel.team', 'events.cancel.global');
        $setupEditable = in_array($event->state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED], strict: true);
        $canViewAutomations = $this->allows(
            $actor,
            $event,
            'automations.view.team',
            'automations.view.global',
        );

        return [
            'edit' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
            ],
            'publish' => [
                'visible' => $canPublish && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
                'enabled' => $canPublish && ! $cancelled && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
            ],
            'prepare' => [
                'visible' => false,
                'enabled' => false,
            ],
            'cancel' => [
                'visible' => $canCancel,
                'enabled' => $canCancel && ! $cancelled && ! in_array($event->state, [
                    EventState::LIVE,
                    EventState::ENDED,
                    EventState::SUSPENDED,
                ], strict: true),
            ],
            'manageLanding' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageRegistrationForm' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageAutomations' => [
                'visible' => $canViewAutomations && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canViewAutomations && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageAudienceBoost' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
            ],
            'suspend' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state !== EventState::SUSPENDED,
            ],
            'reactivate' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state === EventState::SUSPENDED,
            ],
            'forceEnd' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state === EventState::LIVE,
            ],
            'controlRoom' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && in_array($event->state, [
                        EventState::PUBLISHED,
                        EventState::PREPARING,
                        EventState::FAILED,
                        EventState::READY,
                        EventState::LIVE,
                    ], strict: true),

                    && ! $cancelled
                    && in_array($event->state, [
                        EventState::PUBLISHED,
                        EventState::PREPARING,
                        EventState::FAILED,
                        EventState::READY,
                        EventState::LIVE,
                    ], strict: true),
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function allows(User $actor, Event $event, string $teamCapability, string $globalCapability): bool
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows($globalCapability)) {
            return true;
        }

        return $actor->hasTeamPermission($event->team, $teamCapability);
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature\Billing\Support;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Story 1-7d R3 — shared billing-admin fixture trait.
 *
 * Replaces the three near-duplicate `adminOn()` / `adminWithPlan()`
 * helpers that previously lived inline in PlanChangeServiceTest,
 * PlanChangeHubTest, and PlanSelectionTest. The old helpers differed
 * only in cosmetic labels (cus_hub_* vs cus_test_*; visa 1111 vs 4242)
 * and in whether billing_details / PaymentMethod rows were seeded.
 *
 * The trait exposes:
 *   - createBillingAdmin() — canonical entry point, all options explicit
 *   - adminOn()            — alias matching the service-test signature
 *   - adminWithPlan()      — alias matching the selection-test signature
 *
 * Keeping the aliases preserves ~58 existing call sites while unifying
 * the implementation. New tests should use createBillingAdmin().
 *
 * Carbon pinning: callers that require wallclock stability should call
 * `pinTestClock()` in setUp() — optional because the fixtures do not
 * themselves depend on an anchored now() beyond internal arithmetic.
 */
trait BillingTestFixtures
{
    /**
     * Canonical fixture. Creates a verified user, a non-personal team,
     * attaches the user as ADMIN, creates a subscription at the given
     * tier, and (by default) seeds billing_details + a default payment
     * method so downstream service methods have a complete tenant.
     *
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides  columns applied on top of the default Subscription row
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team}
     */
    protected function createBillingAdmin(
        PlanTier $tier,
        int $daysRemaining = 18,
        bool $withBillingDetails = true,
        bool $withPaymentMethod = true,
        array $overrides = [],
    ): array {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $team = Team::factory()->nonPersonal()->create(['user_id' => $owner->id]);
        $team->users()->attach($owner, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $owner->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        $defaults = [
            'plan_tier' => $tier->value,
            'status' => 'active', // enum-literal-allow: factory default; test fixtures use raw DB value strings intentionally
            'starts_at' => now()->subDays(30 - $daysRemaining),
            'current_period_started_at' => now()->subDays(30 - $daysRemaining),
            'current_period_ends_at' => now()->addDays($daysRemaining),
        ];

        $merged = array_merge($defaults, $overrides);

        // Auto-fill grace_period_ends_at when overriding status to grace_period,
        // unless the caller already supplies it. Without this, the Subscription
        // model observer throws LogicException on creation.
        if (
            isset($merged['status'])
            && $merged['status'] === SubscriptionStatus::GRACE_PERIOD->value
            && ! array_key_exists('grace_period_ends_at', $merged)
        ) {
            $merged['grace_period_ends_at'] = now()->addDays(7);
        }

        Subscription::factory()->for($team)->create($merged);

        if ($withBillingDetails) {
            DB::table('billing_details')->insert([
                'team_id' => $team->getKey(),
                'uuid' => (string) Str::uuid(),
                'revolut_customer_id' => 'cus_test_'.$team->getKey(),
                'country_code' => 'TR',
                'legal_name' => 'Test Co',
                'address_line1' => 'Main Street 1',
                'city' => 'Istanbul',
                'postal_code' => '34000',
                'created_at' => now(),
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
        }

        if ($withPaymentMethod) {
            PaymentMethod::query()->create([
                'team_id' => $team->getKey(),
                'external_id' => 'pm_test_'.$team->getKey(),

/**
 * Canonical role identifiers. Enum values are the string keys stored in
 * `roles.key` and the Jetstream `team_user.role` pivot column — they
 * MUST match the role names registered in JetstreamServiceProvider
 * (`admin`, `co-host`, `billing-admin`).

 * Jetstream team-role vocabulary; its value is `system_admin` to avoid
 * collision with the team "admin" role.
 */
enum UserRole: string
{
    case SYSTEM_ADMIN = 'system_admin';
    case ADMIN = 'admin';
    case BILLING_ADMIN = 'billing-admin';
    case CO_HOST = 'co-host';

    /**
     * Get all role values as array
     */
    public static function values(): array
    {
        return array_column(self::cases(), 'value');
    }

    /**
     * Get role label for UI
     */
    public function label(): string
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::SYSTEM_ADMIN => 'System Administrator',
            self::ADMIN => 'Administrator',
            self::BILLING_ADMIN => 'Billing Admin',
            self::CO_HOST => 'Co-host',
        };
    }

    /**
     * The role a workspace creator is auto-assigned to. Jetstream team
     * owners cannot be demoted below this role.
     */
    public static function ownerDefault(): self
    {
        return self::ADMIN;

     * team members. Excludes SYSTEM_ADMIN (platform-scope, never granted via
     * team UI). ADMIN is a workspace role, not ownership transfer.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function assignableTeamRoleValues(): array
    {
        return [
            self::ADMIN->value,
            self::CO_HOST->value,
            self::BILLING_ADMIN->value,
        ];
    }
}

 *
 * Extends ResourcePolicy so all scope resolution (including the SYSTEM_ADMIN
 * global bypass) flows through EffectiveScopeResolver rather than a hand-rolled
 * isSystemAdmin() role short-circuit (Rule 30).
 *
 * Capability strings:
 *   viewAny → events.view.{team,global}
 *   view    → events.view.{team,global}
 *   create  → overridden — @can('create', [Event::class, $team]) supplies Team
 *   update  → events.update.{team,global}
 */
class EventPolicy extends ResourcePolicy
{
    protected string $resourceName = 'events';

    /**
     * viewAny intentionally resolves `events.view.*` (not a separate `events.viewany.*`
     * capability) so any role that can view an event can also list — keeps
     * route(events.view.*) and policy in parity.
     */
    public function viewAny(PermissionSubjectInterface $user): bool
    {
        $scope = $this->scopeResolver->getEffectiveScope(
            $user,
            $this->resourceName,
            PermissionAction::VIEW->value,
        );

        return \in_array($scope, [PermissionScope::OWN->value, PermissionScope::TEAM->value, PermissionScope::GLOBAL->value], true);
    }

    /**
     * Story 2-1 — Admin + Co-host may create events.
     *
     * Overrides ResourcePolicy::create() to handle the Team argument that
     * Laravel passes via @can('create', [Event::class, $team]).
     *
     * When $team is supplied, the check is team-scoped against that team.
     * When $team is absent (e.g. base-class callers), falls through to the
     * scope resolver's current-team resolution — matching base behaviour.
     *
     * $team is nullable with a default to satisfy PHP LSP: the parent
     * declares create(User): bool with no second param, so any override
     * must keep it optional.
     */
    public function create(PermissionSubjectInterface $user, ?Team $team = null): bool
    {
        if ($team !== null) {
            /** @var User $user */
            return $user->hasTeamPermission($team, 'events.create.team');
        }

        // Fallback: no team supplied — resolve via EffectiveScopeResolver
        // (honours events.create.global for SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team tooling).
        $scope = $this->scopeResolver->getEffectiveScope(
            $user,
            $this->resourceName,
            PermissionAction::CREATE->value,
        );

        return in_array($scope, [PermissionScope::TEAM->value, PermissionScope::GLOBAL->value], true);
    }
}

use Tests\Traits\TeamTesting;

/**
 * Base class for feature tests

{

    use PermissionTesting;
    use TeamTesting;

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events;

use App\Enums\PlanTier;
use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\Billing\Support\BillingTestFixtures;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Capsule T1 ATDD — Duplicate an event.
 *
 * Critical path only:
 *   - AC1 named POST route on the Events module
 *   - AC2/AC3 shared action model exposes `duplicate` gated on the create capability
 *   - AC4 endpoint refuses independently of what the UI rendered, with no row written
 *   - AC5/AC6 a successful duplicate is a fresh DRAFT copy in the acting team,
 *     carrying no lifecycle, cancellation or registration state from the source
 */
#[Group('events')]
class EventDuplicateActionTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use BillingTestFixtures;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Cache::flush();
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // AC1 — route contract
    // =========================================================================

    #[Test]
    public function duplicate_route_is_registered_by_name_on_the_events_module(): void
    {
        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('events.duplicate');

        $this->assertNotNull($route, 'Named route [events.duplicate] is not registered.');
        $this->assertSame('events/{event:uuid}/duplicate', $route->uri());
        $this->assertContains('POST', $route->methods());
        $this->assertStringStartsWith(
            'App\Modules\Events\\',
            $route->getActionName(),
            'events.duplicate must be handled by the Events module.',
        );
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // AC2 + AC3 — shared action model
    // =========================================================================

    #[Test]
    public function action_model_exposes_duplicate_for_an_actor_with_the_create_capability(): void
    {
        [$admin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $event = $this->eventFor($admin, EventState::DRAFT);

        $availability = app(EventActionAvailability::class)->for($admin->fresh(), $event);

        $this->assertArrayHasKey('duplicate', $availability);
        $this->assertSame(
            array_keys($availability['edit']),
            array_keys($availability['duplicate']),
            'duplicate entry must share the shape of the existing action entries.',
        );
        $this->assertTrue($availability['duplicate']['visible']);
        $this->assertTrue($availability['duplicate']['enabled']);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function action_model_hides_duplicate_from_an_actor_without_the_create_capability(): void
    {
        // billing-admin holds no events.* team capability.
        [$admin, $team] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $event = $this->eventFor($admin, EventState::DRAFT);

        $billingAdmin = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $billingAdmin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value]);
        $billingAdmin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        $availability = app(EventActionAvailability::class)->for($billingAdmin->fresh(), $event);

        $this->assertArrayHasKey('duplicate', $availability);
        $this->assertFalse($availability['duplicate']['visible']);
        $this->assertFalse($availability['duplicate']['enabled']);
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // AC5 + AC6 — successful duplicate
    // =========================================================================

    #[Test]
    public function duplicating_an_event_creates_one_fresh_draft_copy_in_the_acting_team(): void
    {
        [$admin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);

        $source = $this->eventFor($admin, EventState::PUBLISHED);
        $source->forceFill([
            'cancelled_at' => now(),
            'cancelled_by' => $admin->id,
            'cancel_reason' => 'Speaker dropped out',
        ])->save();
        $this->registrationFor($source);

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->from(route('events.show', $source))
            ->post('/events/'.$source->uuid.'/duplicate');

        $response->assertSessionHasNoErrors();
        $this->assertContains(
            $response->status(),
            [200, 201, 302],
            'Duplicate should be accepted; got HTTP '.$response->status().'.',
        );

        $this->assertSame(2, Event::withoutGlobalScopes()->count(), 'Exactly one new event should exist.');

        $copy = Event::withoutGlobalScopes()
            ->whereKeyNot($source->getKey())
            ->sole();

        $this->assertNotSame($source->uuid, $copy->uuid);
        $this->assertSame(EventState::DRAFT, $copy->state);
        $this->assertSame($admin->fresh()->currentTeam->id, $copy->team_id);

        // AC6 — no lifecycle / cancellation / registration carry-over.
        $this->assertNull($copy->cancelled_at);
        $this->assertNull($copy->cancelled_by);
        $this->assertNull($copy->cancel_reason);
        $this->assertSame(0, $copy->registrations()->withoutGlobalScopes()->count());
        $this->assertSame(1, Registration::withoutGlobalScopes()->count());
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // AC4 — endpoint stands on its own authorization
    // =========================================================================

    #[Test]
    public function endpoint_refuses_an_actor_without_the_create_capability_and_writes_no_event(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $source = $this->eventFor($admin, EventState::DRAFT);

        $billingAdmin = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $billingAdmin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value]);
        $billingAdmin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        $response = $this->actingAs($billingAdmin->fresh())
            ->postJson('/events/'.$source->uuid.'/duplicate');

        $response->assertStatus(403);
        $this->assertSame(1, Event::withoutGlobalScopes()->count());
    }

    #[Test]
    public function endpoint_refuses_an_actor_who_cannot_view_the_source_event_and_writes_no_event(): void
    {
        [$owner] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $source = $this->eventFor($owner, EventState::DRAFT);

        // Admin of an unrelated workspace: holds events.create.team there,
        // but has no visibility of this source event.
        [$outsider] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);

        $response = $this->actingAs($outsider->fresh())
            ->postJson('/events/'.$source->uuid.'/duplicate');

        $this->assertContains(
            $response->status(),
            [403, 404],
            'Cross-workspace duplicate must be refused; got HTTP '.$response->status().'.',
        );
        $this->assertSame(1, Event::withoutGlobalScopes()->count());
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Fixtures
    // =========================================================================

    private function eventFor(User $admin, EventState $state): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()
            ->inState($state)
            ->for($admin->currentTeam)
            ->create(['created_by' => $admin->id]);
    }

    private function registrationFor(Event $event): Registration
    {
        $email = 'registrant-'.$event->id.'@example.test';

        $registration = new Registration;
        $registration->forceFill([
            'uuid' => sprintf('00000000-0000-4000-8000-%012x', $event->id),
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => Hash::make($email),
            'full_name' => 'Registered Attendee',
        ]);
        $registration->save();

        return $registration;
    }
}
